scientific_summary: AlphaFold 3 evolves pair and single representations with Pairformer, then conditions an atom-coordinate diffusion model that recurrently denoises random coordinates into a biomolecular structure.
invariants: MSA embedding is much smaller and simpler; its information passes via the pair representation and MSA is not retained by Pairformer.
Pairformer operates on pair and single representations only; do not invent its inner attention mechanisms.
Diffusion receives pair, single and input representations and operates on raw atomic coordinates plus coarse tokens.
Training predicts true coordinates from noised coordinates; inference starts with random noise and recurrently denoises. Keep these modes visually distinct.
Schematic geometry illustrates artifact type only, not empirical molecular predictions. No AF2 results, RFdiffusion motifs or benchmark claims.

The PDB 1MBO myoglobin illustration is a labelled contextual protein example only. It is not a literal AF3 input tensor, output prediction or benchmark. Training occupies a narrow upper strip in diffusion; recurrent inference occupies the lower main region and its loop enters that same region.
layout: Titles are bold dark text directly on white or ordinary panel background: NO coloured title ribbons, tabs, header bars, white reversed headings, or whole-figure banner. Soft colour highlights only meaningful interior content and the key mechanism; avoid a repeated card-header grid. Use a clear matched family of moderately bold, slightly hand-drawn shaft arrows with solid readable triangular heads and palette-matched ink. Keep planned endpoints and exact centerlines; all shafts continuous beside text, including across model titles. Equal peer regions and clean rectangular outer silhouette remain. One complete 1480×950 rectangular macro footprint from x80 to1560 and y180 to1130, divided into three equal-width 420px columns and three equal-height 250px rows, with consistent 110px horizontal and 100px vertical gutters. Input and Pairformer each span the first two rows at left and right; MSA and Pair + single occupy upper-middle and middle-middle; Random noise, Diffusion Module and Atomic structure fill the three bottom cells. All nine cells are occupied exactly once. Reserve title above the grid and the feedback loop below it. Scientific flow is directionally explicit: MSA goes right into Pairformer, input passes through the upper/middle gutter to Pairformer, Pairformer returns left into pair and single, then conditioning descends into diffusion. No fictional symmetric branch or invented operation. Equal rectangular frames and shared outer edges give balance without duplicating science. Keep the tall input area sparse: one large aligned feature artifact, no extra stages or filler. Inside Input representation reserve the clean white axis-aligned specimen inset [160,260,260,264] for a genuine collected protein image, not a native redraw. Place the caption Protein example · PDB 1MBO below the inset at [110,540,360,45], then native token strip and input feature cells in y610–745. This specimen is a contextual illustration of the input domain only, never an empirical AF3 output or an asserted structural input. Leave the reserved rectangle blank for post-generation compositing. No other blank content slots.
typography: Arial or a coherent clean sans serif. Bold black/dark headings on unpainted background; scientific interior fill only. Short readable labels, no gray microcopy, no visible underscore, mathematical indices genuinely typeset. Reserve labels away from shafts.
